newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Weekend rains forecast in Argentine wheat areas.
newsitem.headline: Weekend rains forecast in Argentine wheat areas.

text.p: Forecasts of rain for the weekend in Argentina's southern wheat belt could cause further harvest delays, traders said Friday.
"Wheat is firm on the news of rain," one trader said. He said it also rained in south Buenos Aires overnight.
But weather for developing maize and soybean crops remains good, traders said.
The Argentine government Meteorological Service forecast storms for the weekend in Buenos Aires and La Pampa provinces.
It said there would be a hot, partially cloudy Friday in the key Buenos Aires province. Temperatures should rise to a maximum of 30 degrees celsius (86 degrees Fahrenheit) in La Plata.

It forecast warm, slightly overcast day in La Pampa, with a maximum temperature of 32 degrees celsius (90 degrees Fahrenheit) in Santa Rosa. Warm, dry weather was also forecast in southern Cordoba but there was a possibility of summer storms in Santa Fe province.
